current_official_controls_note: The current directly governing state or local election-office source controls for this case. National routing pages, generalized official explainers, and archive summaries are routing aids only and are not substitutes for the current official instruction that directly governs the voter's jurisdiction and election scope.
deadline_imminence_note: Do not assume an older FAQ, PDF, screenshot, or cached directory still controls today's path. If the cutoff is near or may already have passed, confirm the current live deadline with the responsible office and pivot immediately to the stated fallback or confirmation path if the original route is no longer operable.
in_person_or_dropoff_fallback_summary: If vote centers, county offices, statewide drop boxes, or other in-person fallback paths remain lawful, publish them.
mail_forwarding_or_pickup_summary: If ballots are not forwardable or must be picked up through another public path, say so explicitly.
minimum_necessary_disclosure_note: Send only the personal information the current official process requires. Do not post or send full Social Security numbers, driver's license numbers, dates of birth, confidential residence details, court papers, custody records, or other sensitive identifiers through public, unverified, or generalized channels.
official_help_path_summary: Name the county or state election office that resolves time-sensitive displacement questions safely.
official_secure_channel_note: Use only the named official website, secure HTTPS form, verified office phone, or in-person office path for sensitive case details and documents. If the current public instructions do not show a secure submission path, call the responsible election office first before sending records.
operability_now_note: Before relying on this path under same-day or near-cutoff pressure, verify that the responsible office, portal, site, or delivery route is still open and operating right now using the latest official hours/closure notice, current update page, or verified office phone.
permanent_relocation_summary: Publish what the voter must do if the move is no longer temporary and the voting residence has changed.
replacement_or_remote_ballot_summary: If replacement ballots, remote-accessible ballots, or other emergency delivery options are available, point to them.

scenarios.ballot_delivery_rule: Explain whether the ballot can be mailed to the temporary address and whether forwarding is unavailable.
scenarios.help_path_rule: Name the office or phone line that resolves the current public answer.
scenarios.in_person_or_dropoff_rule: Point to drop-box, vote-center, or office fallback if mail delivery is too risky.
scenarios.mailing_rule: Explain how to add or change only a temporary mailing address.
scenarios.plain_language: The voter evacuated because of a disaster but still considers the home residence the place that controls local contests.
scenarios.replacement_or_remote_access_rule: Point to replacement-ballot or remote-access options if delivery is unreliable.
scenarios.residence_rule: State whether the permanent residential/home address remains the voting address for districting.

scenarios.ballot_delivery_rule: State how the ballot will be sent during the transition.
scenarios.help_path_rule: Name the office that can safely resolve a permanent-relocation question close to the election.
scenarios.in_person_or_dropoff_rule: Point to same-county, vote-center, or other in-person fallback when applicable.
scenarios.mailing_rule: Explain any mailing-address steps that apply while the residential update is pending.
scenarios.plain_language: The voter will not be returning to the former home and needs the public rule for updating the voting residence.
scenarios.replacement_or_remote_access_rule: Point to any lawful fallback if the ordinary path cannot be completed in time.
scenarios.residence_rule: State whether the voter must re-register or update the residential address and by what deadline.

superseding_notice_note: Older pages, PDFs, screenshots, packet inserts, or archived summaries may remain visible. Follow the most current official notice, form, correction, update, or replacement instruction and use the dated or last-updated cue when available.
temporary_displacement_summary: Publish whether a temporarily displaced voter keeps the permanent residential/home address for voting and changes only the mailing or delivery path.
temporary_mailing_address_summary: Publish how to provide a temporary mailing address for the current election and which methods remain open.
unresolved_conflict_stop_note: If current official materials still materially conflict, disagree, or leave a controlling gap, do not synthesize an answer from fragments. Treat that unresolved conflict as a stop condition and use the responsible official office or help path for case-specific confirmation; move to the rights/safety escalation lane when the conflict is paired with likely wrongful denial, intimidation, discrimination, or unsafe exposure.
